hooks.command: IN=$(cat); SID=$(printf '%s' "$IN" | jq -r '.session_id // "nosession"'); FLAG="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/cc-schema-$SID.flag"; if [ ! -f "$FLAG" ]; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Run ToolSearch for the concretecms tool schema BEFORE this call. Concrete CMS param names are case-sensitive (e.g. pageID not pageId) and unknown keys are silently dropped, surfacing as a generic 404. Do: ToolSearch query select:<tool-name> (or a concretecms keyword search), then retry. This gate clears for the rest of the session after any concretecms ToolSearch."}}'; fi
IN=$(cat); SID=$(printf '%s' "$IN" | jq -r '.session_id // "nosession"'); if printf '%s' "$IN" | grep -qi 'concretecms'; then touch "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/cc-schema-$SID.flag"; fi
